blocks.value: What is COMEDK UGET Exam?

COMEDK UGET exam is a common entrance test held at the national level for admission to around 150 unaided private engineering colleges in Karnataka . COMEDK full form is the Consortium of Medical, Engineering and Dental Colleges of Karnataka that conducts UGET. It is an autonomous body that is entrusted with the responsibility of organising UGET. The undergraduate entrance test (UGET) is a computer-based test for admission to BE courses. This test is open to all eligible students in the country. Seats in the colleges are allotted based on COMEDK UGET scores via an online counselling process .
